Artifical Intelligence

Filed under: #pinned

My eternal promise

All writing and code is done solely by me. All art is either done solely by me or drawn by other humans (who will be credited).

I will never ever ever use an AI model for any part of this website, since it's a personal project; as we all know, artificial intelligence is deeply impersonal.

AI in my daily life

I don't use AI even outside of my website (besides when it's forced onto me, by virtue of being on the internet). Perhaps this is hell, or humanity's headed straight there, or I've done something terrible in a past life and that's why the world sucks.

Vocal synthesis

I am aware vocal synthesizers, such as Vocaloid, Voisona, and Diffsinger UTAU use generative artifical intelligence. This is fine because it runs locally on your computer, and is done with consent from the voice providers.
